description: How TmSidebar compares an item's Href with the current location when AutoActive is on. Exact marks only the page itself; Prefix also marks a parent entry for its sub-pages, on a segment boundary — so '/settings' matches '/settings/profile' but never '/settings-old'. The root '/' entry stays exact in both modes.

members.name: Exact
members.description: The item is active only when its path equals the current path — '/settings' is NOT active on '/settings/profile'. The default, because it never lights up two entries for one page.

members.name: Prefix
members.description: The item is active when its path equals the current path OR the current path continues it ('/settings' is active on '/settings/profile'). Use it for a section entry that owns its sub-pages; a segment boundary is respected, so '/settings' never matches '/settings-old'.
